eyebrow: SWAP, and SWAP from three CNOTs
caption: Three alternating CNOTs reproduce SWAP exactly — the standard trick when hardware has no native SWAP.

steps.label: 8x8 matrix on 3 qubits: two controls, one target
steps.sub: Flips the target if and only if BOTH controls are |1⟩

steps.label: Toffoli|110⟩ = |111⟩, Toffoli|111⟩ = |110⟩
steps.sub: The target bit flips only in these two rows

steps.label: Toffoli|100⟩ = |100⟩, unchanged
steps.sub: Only one control set — the "both" condition correctly fails

steps.label: With the target starting at |0⟩
steps.sub: Toffoli writes control1 AND control2 into the target

steps.label: Classical AND is not invertible
steps.sub: You can't recover both inputs from a single output bit

steps.label: Toffoli is unitary — automatically its own clean inverse
steps.sub: Apply it twice and you're back to the original 3-qubit state

steps.label: Every quantum gate must be reversible
steps.sub: Toffoli relocates information instead of discarding it, the way AND does

steps.label: Can't be built from 1- and 2-qubit gates alone
steps.sub: Needs ancilla qubits and a longer sequence — Chapter 4 covers exactly how

subtitle: Entanglement stops being abstract — built gate by gate, verified with real numbers.
